Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses MANUFACTURING, SUPPLY, AND COMMISSIONING OF

ELECTRIC ROAD SWEEPER MACHINE – 1,200 LITRE TANK CAPACITY TECHNICAL QUALIFICATION CRITERIA 1. Past Supply Experience The Bidder/OEM must have successfully supplied a minimum of five (5) electric road sweeper machines wi th litter picking, each having a tank capacity of 600 litres or higher, to any Government Department, PSU, i ndustrial organization, or private organization. Copies of the relevant Purchase Orders/Work Orders and/or Completion Certificates shall be submitted as documentary evidence 2. Supply of the Same Machine The Bidder/OEM must have supplied the same or similar make and model of electric road sweeper machine with litter picking as offered against this tender. A copy of the relevant Purchase Order/Work Order and/or Completion Certificate shall be submitted as proof 3. Government Contract Experience The Bidder/OEM must have successfully executed at least one Government contract valued at a minimum of ₹1 crore for the supply of 100% electric road sweeper machines. A copy of the relevant Purchase Order/ Work Order shall be submitted as documentary evidence. 4. OEM Authorisation The Bidder must be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) or an OEM-authorised bidder. A valid auth orisation certificate issued by the OEM or an OEM authorisation/approval certificate issued by a Governme nt-authorised agency such as RITES or an equivalent agency shall be submitted, as applicable. 5. Patent The OEM/Bidder should hold at least one valid patent relating to any type of cleaning machine. A copy of t he patent certificate shall be submitted as supporting evidence. 6. Average Annual Turnover The Bidder must have a minimum average annual turnover of ₹1 crore during the last three (3) financial ye ars. A turnover certificate duly certified by a Chartered Accountant (CA), indicating the financial-year-wise turnover, shall be submitted. 7. Technical Drawings The Bidder/OEM shall submit the General Arrangement (GA) drawing, 3D model drawings, and isometric dr awings of the offered machine. 8. OEM Recognition/Registration The OEM must be recognised/registered with the Government through a recognised vendor assessment au thority. Relevant registration/recognition or vendor assessment documents shall be submitted. 9. Pre-Bid Meeting Participation in the pre-bid meeting shall be mandatory. Non-participation shall render the bidder liable for disqualification, subject to the tender conditions. 10. Service and Support Infrastructure The Bidder/OEM must have a dedicated service engineer located in Jammu & Kashmir to provide service a nd support for the offered machine. Documentary proof of the service engineer's availability/deployment s hall be submitted. 11. ISO Certifications The Bidder/OEM shall possess and submit valid certificates for the following management system standard s: • ISO 9001:2015 – Quality Management System. • ISO 14001:2015 – Environmental Management System.

• ISO 45001:2018 – Occupational Health and Safety Management System. 12. Delivery Period The machine shall be delivered within ninety (60) days from the date of placement of the Purchase Order/ Work Order. 13. Warranty and After-Sales Support The Bidder/OEM shall provide the following warranty and after-sales support: • Battery Warranty: Minimum three (3) years of comprehensive warranty coverage. • Machine Warranty: Twenty-four (24) months on the complete machine, covering structural, mechanical, and electrical components. • Critical Spares: Commitment to supply critical spare parts for a minimum period of seven (7) years. • Service Support: 24×7 service helpline with a maximum response time of twenty-four (24) hours from re ceipt of a breakdown complaint. 14. Non-Blacklisting Declaration The Bidder shall submit an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹300, duly executed by the authorised signatory, declaring that the Bidder/organisation has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Government Department, PSU, or other authority. The affidavit shall be submitted along with the technical bid. 15. Local Content The offered machine shall have a minimum local content of 85%. The Bidder shall submit a declaration/cer tificate confirming the local content, in accordance with the applicable Government of India guidelines. 16. PM2.5 and PM10 Certification The Bidder/OEM shall submit a valid test report/certificate demonstrating compliance with the applicable P M2.5 and PM10 particulate matter emission/dust-control requirements for the offered machine, issued by a competent or accredited testing laboratory. Note: The minimum average annual turnover amount under Clause 6 is intentionally left blank and must b e finalised before publication of the tender. Muncipal Committee shall provide the following on free of cost basis. 1. Parking shed with charging point with free electricity at secured or Guarded for Equipment safety. 2. Remove all obstructions and hindrance within the road width/ area of operation where work is to be carri ed out. 3. Provide free water and space for dumping of collected waste/litter within the stretch of area (i.e., 1Km) where work has to be carried out.
